gates.name: Preservation, source reconciliation and frozen contract
gates.acceptance: All originals bound; restoration established; exact adopted-source coverage resolved; one coherent implementable contract. Package authoring alone does not satisfy this runtime kickoff gate.

gates.name: Real controlled operating skeleton
gates.acceptance: Real canonical history, authority, supervisor, observation and bounded effect cooperate with success, denial and crash evidence.

gates.name: Continuing intelligence core
gates.acceptance: Current context, memory, model, Companion, staging, review and effects produce accurate durable continuity through the native workflow.

gates.name: Declared security and extended profiles
gates.acceptance: All chosen profile controls are evidenced; unsupported mandatory lanes stay open and unavailable. External/hardware evidence cannot be inferred from local fixtures.

gates.name: Preserved migration
gates.acceptance: All supported schemas conserve data by category and cutover/restore rehearsals succeed without activating the live profile.

gates.name: Exact installed qualified candidate
gates.acceptance: Full-stack semantic, performance, independent-verifier, packaging, clean installed and OS-isolated results bind the exact candidate profile.

gates.name: Endurance and independent/hardware assurance
gates.acceptance: Actual elapsed-time campaign and the required real independent/domain/hardware gates are completed with attributable evidence.

gates.name: Owner-authorized cutover and release
gates.acceptance: Explicit current owner decision, exact artifacts, restored/verified data path, one live authority and separately authorized publishing/signing.
